# aibris v0.8.2

This is a performance patch for cleanup. When many small orphaned agent-state
entries are eligible, `clean` no longer re-scans the whole agent-state store
for every target, so large batches finish much faster while the fail-closed
safety contract is unchanged.

## Highlights

- The expensive full agent-state re-scan (walking `~/.claude/projects` and
  `~/.cursor/projects`, parsing session records, and estimating sizes) now runs
  once per cleanup batch and is shared across all targets, instead of once per
  target.
- The shared scan is invalidated before each mutation whenever the set of
  agent-state entries changes (an entry added, removed, or renamed), so a newly
  created overlapping entry is still discovered and stays protected.
- A transient scan failure no longer blocks the rest of the batch; scan errors
  are not cached.

## Safety

- Entries already known to overlap a target are still revalidated live per
  target immediately before mutation.
- Newly created overlapping `live` or `undetermined` agent state still refuses
  the affected target, because an entry-set change forces a fresh scan before
  the next mutation.
- No eligibility rules, protections, or default policy changed.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sungjunlee/aibris/blob/v0.8.2/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete curated change list.
